The plate is square and looks like a dinner plate of about 24 cm per side. I estimated the weight of each item from the area it covers and its height.

**Scrambled eggs:** They cover about 20% of the plate, roughly 110 cm². The pile is about 2 cm high, which gives around 150 cm³. Scrambled egg is loose, so I took about 0.7 g/cm³, which comes to roughly 110 g. I'll call it 105 g.

**Roasted broccoli:** It covers a smaller area, about 60 cm², and is about 2.5 cm high. That gives roughly 60 g of broccoli. Roasting adds some oil, but I can't see any oil pooled on the plate, so I'm not listing it separately.
